dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for a housing loan and I wanted to check the status of my application. Can you help me with that?
dialogue.agent: Yes, I can help with that. Your loan application has been approved and the loan has been originated.

dialogue.user: That's great to hear! Can you tell me the interest rate that was assigned to my loan? Also, what are the total costs associated with this loan?
dialogue.agent: The interest rate for your loan is 6.375%. The total costs associated with the loan are $5,622.19.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. Can you also confirm the term of the loan and whether there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your loan term is 360 months. The loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage and it does not have any negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Great, thank you for confirming that. Has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution? And what is my debt-to-income ratio?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has been sold to a credit union, mortgage company, or finance company. Your debt-to-income ratio is 37%.

dialogue.user:
Got it. One last question: what type of loan product was I approved for?

Also, I'm a bit surprised by the interest rate. I was expecting something lower. Is there any reason why the rate is on the higher side?

Also, I'm a bit concerned about the debt-to-income ratio. What does a ratio of 37% mean for my application and financial health?

I think that's all I need to know. Thank you for your help!

<Very Satisfied> - The agent provided clear and detailed information about my loan status, interest rate, total costs, loan term, and other relevant details. They were polite, professional, and responsive to my questions. I feel well-informed and satisfied with the interaction.
